title.narrative: of individuals participated in specific community centre unstructured PSS and informal education activities (M/W/B/G)

description.narrative: The indicator measures the number of individuals who have taken part in psychosocial support (PSS) and informal education (NFE) activities at specific community centers. The indicator is further disaggregated by gender (M for male, W for female, B for boys, and G for girls) to capture the participation of different demographic groups.

comment.narrative: During the pilot phase of the CVE program a total of 1129 individuals identified as Beneficiaries BNFs actively participated in specific community centers unstructured psychosocial support PSS and informal education activities.

title.narrative: of safe referrals made to specialised protection services for persons at risk.

description.narrative: The indicator measures the number of referrals made to dedicated protection services for individuals who are identified as being at risk. This indicator focuses on ensuring the safety and wellbeing of vulnerable individuals by connecting them with appropriate and specialized support services.

comment.narrative: During the pilot phase of the program a total of 32 cases were successfully referred to dedicated protection services. These referrals were made to specialized services that cater to the needs of individuals at risk ensuring their safety and providing them with the necessary support and assistance.

Setting a target of 50 reflects the programs commitment to expanding its reach and impact in identifying individuals at risk and ensuring their access to the appropriate support and protection services. By aiming to increase the number of safe referrals the program seeks to address the needs of a larger number of vulnerable individuals and contribute to their safety and wellbeing.

description.narrative: The indicator measures the number of individuals, disaggregated by gender who have enhanced their employment prospects as a result of participating in livelihood interventions.This indicator recognizes the significance of livelihood interventions in improving individuals skills, knowledge, and abilities, thus increasing their chances of finding meaningful and sustainable employment.

Indirect beneficiaries on the other hand represent the family members or individuals within those households who also experience positive impacts as a result of the intervention.

title.narrative: of integrative complexity Thinking (ICT) model developed to increase individuals ability to think critically.

description.narrative: This indicator measures the number of models or frameworks specifically designed to enhance individuals capacity for integrative complexity thinking. Integrative complexity thinking refers to the ability to consider multiple perspectives, synthesize diverse information, and engage in critical analysis when addressing complex issues.

comment.narrative: NPA and its partners have planned to develop an Integrative Complexity Thinking ICT model specifically designed for use in Countering Violent Extremism CVE efforts. The ICT model aims to enhance individuals ability to think critically and analytically when addressing the complexities associated with violent extremism.

title.narrative: of research studies / policy recommendation papers on trends and challenges of radicalisation.

description.narrative: The indicator of research studies / policy recommendation papers on trends and challenges of radicalization measures the quantity or number of studies and policy recommendation papers that have been conducted or produced, focusing on analyzing trends and challenges related to radicalization.

comment.narrative: During the previous phase of the CVE program one of NPAs partners JFL successfully produced a research study focusing on trends and challenges of radicalization. This study provided valuable insights into the dynamics of radicalization including key trends risk factors and potential intervention strategies.

NPA and its partners have set the intention to conduct three studies and policy papers on the trends and challenges related to radicalization. These research initiatives aim to deepen the understanding of radicalization processes identify emerging trends and address the evolving challenges in countering violent extremism. By conducting these studies and policy papers NPA and its partners are committed to generating evidencebased knowledge and providing valuable insights that can inform policy development programmatic interventions and the overall efforts to prevent and counter radicalization effectively.

comment.narrative: In the pilot phase of the program a 35 increase in knowledge and capacity was achieved among the CSOs and community members who were involved. However since the program is now targeting a new audience the baseline value starts at 0 for this new groups.

Since the baseline value for the new phase is 0 the objective is to achieve a 40 increase in the knowledge and capacity of the CSOs and community members compared to their initial level during this particular phase.

description.narrative: This indicator measures the quantity or number of systems put in place to enable early identification of radicalization indicators and facilitate timely responses, with the integration of digital instruments and technologies.

comment.narrative: NPA and its partners intend to establish an Early Warning and Early Response EWER system that aims to enhance their ability to prevent and respond to radicalization effectively. This system will leverage digital instruments and technologies to enable timely identification of potential indicators and facilitate swift targeted responses. The EWER system will be designed to proactively detect early signs of radicalization enabling stakeholders to intervene at the earliest stages and prevent further escalation. It will incorporate digital tools such as data analysis social media monitoring and online surveillance to gather relevant information and identify emerging trends and patterns associated with radicalization.

description.narrative: Number of emerging conflicts identified by early warning systems

comment.narrative: This indicator represents the number of early response interventions delivered as part of the EWER system to mitigate rising tensions and conflict risks with a total planned of 10 response interventions.

This indicator reflects the number of early response interventions provided as a component of the EWER system to alleviate escalating tensions and conflict risks. As of now NPAs Partners have not implemented these responses within the EWER system. This activity is scheduled to take place in the first quarter of 2024 aligning with the emerging conflicts identified by the EWER system.
